settings.hero_title: Building resilient communities for a sustainable future.
settings.hero_text: We work with communities, especially women, girls and young people in Northern Ghana, to expand access to quality education, strengthen livelihoods, and build resilience to climate and social challenges.
settings.vision: A resilient and inclusive Northern Ghana where every child, woman, girl, young person and vulnerable household has the opportunity to live safely, learn, prosper and participate meaningfully in community development.
settings.mission: To empower vulnerable and underserved communities through quality education, child protection, women’s and girls’ empowerment, climate-resilient agriculture, youth development, water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), sustainable livelihoods and meaningful community participation.
settings.featured_text: We are committed to ensuring that every girl in Northern Ghana can learn, grow and live free from violence and discrimination.
settings.featured_points:
Keep girls in school
Strengthen child protection
Support families and communities
Create safe and inclusive learning environments
settings.about_story:
The Northern Community Resilience Initiative (NCRI-Ghana) is a community-focused, development-oriented organisation based in Saboba, Northern Region, Ghana. We are committed to working with vulnerable and underserved communities to advance inclusive development, protect children’s rights, expand educational opportunities, promote gender equality, strengthen livelihoods and build resilient communities.

We believe that sustainable development begins when communities are empowered to identify their priorities, participate in decisions that affect their lives and take collective action to create lasting change. Our approach brings together community members, children and young people, women, families, traditional authorities, local institutions, civil society organisations and development partners to address local challenges and promote equitable opportunities.

NCRI-Ghana seeks to create an environment in which every child can learn and thrive, every woman and girl can participate meaningfully in development, young people can contribute to their communities, and vulnerable households can access opportunities that strengthen their well-being and resilience.
settings.policies_intro: Good governance is how we earn trust. Our policies set out how NCRI-Ghana protects people, safeguards resources and answers to the communities it serves. Approved documents are published here for anyone to read and download.
settings.resources_intro: Reports, toolkits, briefs and training materials from NCRI-Ghana. Everything here is free to download.
settings.mel_intro: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is how we check that our work is reaching the people it should, is making a real difference, and is getting better over time.
settings.mel_monitoring: We track activities, participation and results against agreed indicators, collecting data with communities and reviewing it regularly.
settings.mel_evaluation: We assess what changed, for whom and why, through periodic reviews and, as programmes mature, independent evaluations.
settings.mel_learning: We share what works and what does not with communities and partners, and use it to improve our programmes and decisions.
settings.impact_note: These are planning targets for 2027, not results achieved to date. Progress is measured against the lower end of each target range and will be updated as results are verified.
settings.partnerships_intro: Lasting resilience is built through partnership. We welcome collaboration with communities, government institutions, schools, traditional leaders, civil society organisations, foundations, development partners, responsible businesses and individual supporters.
settings.partnerships_ways:
Programme partnership | Co-design and deliver activities in education, protection, livelihoods, climate or governance.
Funding partnership | Support defined programmes with multi-year or project funding and clear reporting.
Technical partnership | Share expertise, training, research or tools that strengthen communities and our team.
Community partnership | Work with schools, traditional authorities and local groups to lead change from within.
settings.getinvolved_intro: Be part of the change. NCRI-Ghana welcomes volunteers, donors, community groups, public institutions, civil society organisations and development partners who share our commitment to safer childhoods, equal opportunities, sustainable livelihoods and resilient communities across Northern Ghana. Choose how you would like to contribute, or contact us to explore a community-led collaboration.
